items.label: Quilted Cylinder Bucket Bag
items.value: Crafted from soft vegan leather (PU) featuring an elegant diamond quilting pattern across the body of this distinctive cylinder bucket bag.

items.label: Compact & Structured Silhouette
items.value: This structured cylinder purse maintains its crisp shape, measuring a convenient 5.5" (L) x 4.7" (W) x 6.3" (H) - the perfect small handbag for essentials like phone, cardholder, keys.

items.label: Versatile 3-Way Carry
items.value: Easily transition between crossbody, shoulder, or hand-carry modes. Features detachable and adjustable vegan leather straps plus dual top handles for polished styling.

items.label: Smooth Zipper Closure & Base Studs
items.value: An uniquely shaped metal zipper glides effortlessly for secure closure. Protective metal studs on the bag's base enhance durability and scratch resistance.

items.label: Sophisticated Design with Gold Accents
items.value: Elevated by premium gold-tone hardware throughout. Combines the timeless quilted look, vegan leather practicality, and versatile carrying options in one chic handbag.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash only. Avoid bleach. Do not iron. Do not dry clean. Store in a cool, dry place.
